notes: gold_files are the doc basenames that actually contain the answer, verified by
reading the corpus. They are the grading key: a model is measured on whether
retrieval surfaces these files, not on how the generated prose reads.
primary_files is the subset that is strictly necessary - a run that misses a
primary file cannot have answered the question from context.
A primary_files entry may be a nested list: any one of those files satisfies it.
